purpose: Teach: 至極/入団/簡易裁判所/身動き/座標/品番/邦題/体勢

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様の評価は至極良好です
lines.en: Our VIP clients' evaluations have been excellent.
lines.style: Brisk, professional delivery. Clear enunciation on the key evaluation word. Steady pace, matter-of-fact. No inflection that suggests doubt or hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の入団研修を計画しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared a training plan for the new hires.
lines.style: Cooperative, attentive. Slight nod in the voice on 'prepared.' Warm without overselling. Ready to move forward together on the next point.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 簡易裁判所への申し立てを検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's consider filing with the small claims court.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Measured opening. A touch of careful deliberation on 'consider'—this is a decision being posed, not handed down. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スケジュール上、身動きが取れない時期です
lines.en: Yes. We're in a period where the schedule is too tight to move.
lines.style: Factual, slightly constrained. A faint grimace underneath the politeness—acknowledging the bind without complaint. Even pace, but a subtle tension held in the chest.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトの座標軸を再設定しましょう
lines.en: We should reset the project's strategic axis.
lines.style: Directive and clear. Slight emphasis on 'reset'—this is a real pivot, not a minor adjustment. Confident but not arrogant. Lean into the decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い品番の在庫を一掃します
lines.en: Yes. I'll clear out the old inventory stock.
lines.style: Cooperative acknowledgment. A sense of settling in for real work on 'clear out.' Practical, no-nonsense. Brief but solid—the commitment is there.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 輸入小説の邦題を社内投票で決めましょう
lines.en: Let's have the team vote on a Japanese title for the imported novel.
lines.style: Collaborative and light. Open invitation in the tone—this is a chance for voices. Not a top-down call. Slight lift at the end, inviting participation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様対応の体勢を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we're ready to handle customer inquiries.
lines.style: Closing statement, warm and assured. Settling in with quiet competence. Final word lands softly but decisively. The team is prepared.
